proves.claim: clause 1: with gate.jsdocCheck on, a changed source file whose exported function has no JSDoc summary or a stale @param name fails, naming file and function.

gate.io-static-check-registry.jsdoc-fail.why: Without it, the JSDoc class could fail old debt or run with its setting off.

proves.claim: clause 2: the jsdoc class is a growth check, so a summary already missing on accepted main does not fail when the file is touched, and with the setting off it reports nothing.

gate.io-static-check-registry.jsdoc-grow.why: Without it, the JSDoc class could fail old debt or run with its setting off.
